completion_notes: The Lounge starts in public mode: anyone who reaches the address opens the client without logging in, and the IRC networks added are lost when the session ends.

Named accounts need private mode. Stop the container, set public: false in /config/config.js, start it again and create each user with: pct exec <CTID> -- env THELOUNGE_HOME=/config s6-setuidgid abc thelounge add <user>
The command asks for a password that is not echoed. After creating the users, the web interface asks for a user name and a password.

tagline.en_US: Thelounge (a fork of shoutIRC) is a web IRC client that you host on your own server.

description.en_US: The Lounge is a self-hosted web IRC client for chatting on IRC networks. It provides a browser-based interface to manage connections and communicate across multiple channels. Once set up, it keeps you connected and preserves chat scrollback history.

tips: After logging in, you can add IRC networks, with defaults preset for networks such as Freenode.
